name: tdeemon
description: AI-first nutrition tracker with an adaptive TDEE.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (tdeemon.db), its snapshots, and this install's secret key and first password (.icestore/). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: tdeemon web app and API, published on host as 6722

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: TDEEMON_BASE_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6722, or use your https domain. Invite links and single sign-on use it.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The first admin's email. The account is made on the first start with a password shown in the app's logs (CREDENTIALS box).
